newsitem.title: USA: Ernst & Young adds Emcor's risk management group.
newsitem.headline: Ernst & Young adds Emcor's risk management group.

text.p: Ernst & Young LLP added Emcor's global risk management group to its consulting practice on Monday, Ernst & Young said in a news release.

Robert Baldoni, who headed Emcor's global risk management group for 11 years, will continue to design risk management programs for multinational corporations and other end-users in Ernst & Young's risk management and regulatory practice.
Emcor is a private money and risk management firm based in Irvington, N.Y.
"It was a very nice fit," Baldoni said in an interview about joining Ernst & Young. "While they (Ernst & Young) had some focus on the end-user, they didn't have a major focus."
Baldoni has created risk management programs, such as value-at-risk applications, for corporations with financial exposure in currencies, interest rates and commodities.
Most of Ernst & Young's risk management clients are the dealers, brokers and financial institutions that make markets in derivative products.
Baldoni will also work with Ernst & Young's Comprehensive Risk Management Framework, which examines all types of risk within a company, not just risk from interest rate or currency exposure, he said.
"There are all kinds of elements of risk in a company that can be looked at under one umbrella," Baldoni said. ((Derivatives desk 312-408-8750;E-mail derivatives@reuters.com))
